assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / reference-guided painted game asset.
Asset type: production-quality transparent 2D forging hearth, suitable for the center of an existing Chinese ink-painting game crafting interface.
Input image 1 is a STYLE, MATERIAL and CAMERA reference: the existing refined ink-workshop painting. Match its fine hand-painted stone edges, worn bronze fittings, restrained patina, charcoal ink outlines, subtle watercolor and aged mineral colors. Do not reproduce the whole room or mountains.
Primary request: create ONE isolated EMPTY tabletop forging hearth. A broad low rectangular stone-and-aged-bronze heat basin, front view with the same gently elevated three-quarter angle as the reference workbench. Wide enough for a horizontally held sword, with a broad open shallow central dark-grey heat bed, a low rear wall, two compact shoulders, and a clearly defined thick foreground rim. Ancient Chinese artisan construction, believable heavy joined stone and dull bronze, restrained carved edge detail following the reference, finely rendered chipped corners, soot and soft broad brush texture. Refined painted game art, coherent large forms, with the same finish quality as the reference, not a flat diagram, not a vector icon, not a photoreal 3D render.
Composition: landscape approximately 3:2, entire object visible centered with generous transparent padding. Hearth occupies about 85% of image width and 60% of height, foreground base fully inside frame. Empty basin is easy to identify and has room to overlay separate fire and materials. No high chimney, roof, distant scenery, floor or unrelated tools.
Color: matte desaturated grey-green stone, muted charcoal heat bed, dark weathered bronze and tiny old brass accents; clear readable midtones, do not crush to black. Soft neutral daylight from upper left, no baked warm fire illumination.
Constraints: NO FIRE, NO EMBERS, NO RED GLOW, NO SMOKE, NO WEAPON, NO MATERIALS, NO text, no labels, no runes, no logo, no border, no UI. Genuinely transparent alpha background and transparent surrounding space, no beige paper rectangle, no checkerboard painted in, no detached cast shadow. Keep object edges clean with delicate painted irregularities. This is the empty structural layer for a future replaceable flame.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE transparent RGBA sprite sheet of a single amber workshop forging flame, FOUR animation frames laid out in a strictly regular 2 columns by 2 rows grid.
Input image 1: original Chinese ink-workshop painting, STYLE reference only. Input image 2: empty stone-and-bronze hearth, SCALE, VIEW and MATERIAL reference only. Do not draw either environment or hearth in the output.
Primary request: polished hand-painted flame effect to be composited into the broad open heat bed of this hearth. Match the original game's refined ink-and-mineral watercolor, fine broken brush edges and believable material drawing. Several interwoven tapered tongues with a compact ochre yellow core, restrained burnt orange and vermilion edges, transparent wisps. Soft asymmetric curves, varied thickness, organic flowing shapes, readable detail; do not simplify to flat vector teardrops or photoreal flames. No global glow, bloom or broad smoke.
Composition: landscape 3:2 transparent sheet, four equal-size cells, 2 columns and 2 rows. Each cell contains exactly the SAME flame source and intensity, the same camera, scale, anchor and palette; only the flame tips curl and change naturally in four successive loop poses. The base is broad and low, spanning about 65% of each cell width, at the same 82% cell height baseline. Flame reaches about 30% cell height, leaving generous transparent padding on every edge. Frame 4 smoothly leads to frame 1. Nothing may cross cell boundaries. No cell outlines, labels or drawn checkerboard.
Constraints: only fire and a few small painted ember shapes contiguous with its base, no detached floating spark shower. NO stone, furnace, metal, floor, background, paper, weapon, hands, materials, text, symbols, numbered levels or watermark. Genuine alpha transparency all around and between the four frames, no white or dark matte, no cast shadow. Do not use four different colors or four levels: this is one visual source animated through four poses, actual fire grades are undecided.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: empty-fire background variant for the existing Chinese ink-painting forging workshop game UI.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the current polished workshop background. Preserve its existing composition, original wide landscape aspect ratio (about 16:9), camera, central long stone workbench, gold-bronze relief on its front, tools, stone quenching trough at lower right, wooden posts and bamboo blinds, distant mountains and pine, parchment paper, soft daylight and refined ink brush drawing. Preserve all those elements as closely as possible. Do not redesign, crop or enlarge the scene.
Change ONLY the orange hot fire in the narrow rear-right forge trough immediately behind the tools, beside the right wooden post. Make that exact forge channel cold and empty: replace the visible orange fire/embers and their tiny warm reflections with neutral charcoal-grey stone/soot consistent with the existing surrounding forge construction. It must look like the same unlit workshop. Preserve that channel's edges and perspective, do not erase the furnace structure or tools around it.
The full central table surface must stay clear and unchanged, ready for a separately composited hearth asset. Keep the original detailed hand-painted finish and muted grey-green stone, aged bronze, sepia paper palette.
Constraints: no fire, no glow, no smoke anywhere; no added furnace, no new tools, no people, no weapon, no UI panels, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. This is a clean background layer, not a mockup. Opaque image, same wide framing and generous clear paper on the left as the original.
